mapper.update: update branch set clan_id=#{clanId}, parent_id=#{parentId}, branch_name=#{branchName}, branch_path=#{branchPath}, level=#{level}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, founder_person_id=#{founderPersonId}, migration_from=#{migrationFrom}, migration_to=#{migrationTo}, manager_member_id=#{managerMemberId}, description=#{description}, status=#{status}, created_at=#{createdAt}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} where id=#{id}
mapper.select: with recursive branch_tree(id, parent_id, clan_id, visited_ids) as ( select b.id, b.parent_id, b.clan_id, array[b.id] from branch b where b.clan_id=#{clanId} and b.id in #{id} union all select child.id, child.parent_id, child.clan_id, parent.visited_ids || child.id from branch child join branch_tree parent on child.parent_id=parent.id where child.clan_id=#{clanId} and not child.id=any(parent.visited_ids) ) select distinct id from branch_tree order by id
